stages.instructions: Copy in listed order. These files add helpers; existing routes are not switched to them by this stage.
Copy these callers before the shared manager. They handle creation failure and retain the successful response fields.

Deploy these three files together in one release switch, or pause requests while replacing them. createItem retains three arguments and owns its transaction. The two outer-transaction callers use the internal writer. Do not mix this stage's files with the previous transaction-flag implementation. Verify root, child, subaccount, v2 batch and CSV overwrite before proceeding.
These routes can be copied individually after stage 02. Each adds request validation/error handling or uses the shared prepared writers. Validate the route you copy before moving to the next.
Copy the property validator after the callers and routes. Stage 02 already validates binary writes independently; this step aligns the shared property validator.
